mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_group e JOIN shop c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.shop_group_id = e.shop_group_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name AND c.name = i.name )

SELECT g.name AS group_name, i.name AS name FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id JOIN shop_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN shop c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.shop_group_id = e.shop_group_id AND c.name = i.name WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY g.template_shop_group_id, i.template_shop_id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(shop_group_id), 0) FROM shop_group WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(shop_id), 0) FROM shop WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_group (user_id, name, description) SELECT #{userId}, g.name, g.description FROM template_shop_group g WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_group e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name)

INSERT INTO shop (user_id, shop_group_id, name, description, url) SELECT #{userId}, e.shop_group_id, i.name, i.description, i.url FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id JOIN shop_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop c WHERE c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.shop_group_id = e.shop_group_id AND c.name = i.name )

INSERT INTO thumbnail_image (user_id, target_type, target_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) SELECT #{userId}, 'SHOP_GROUP', e.shop_group_id, t.file_path, t.original_name, t.file_size FROM template_shop_group g JOIN shop_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE_SHOP_GROUP' AND t.target_id = g.template_shop_group_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND e.shop_group_id > #{maxGroupId}

INSERT INTO thumbnail_image (user_id, target_type, target_id, file_path, original_name, file_size) SELECT #{userId}, 'SHOP', c.shop_id, t.file_path, t.original_name, t.file_size FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id JOIN shop_group e ON e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = g.name JOIN shop c ON c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.shop_group_id = e.shop_group_id AND c.name = i.name JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.target_type = 'TEMPLATE_SHOP' AND t.target_id = i.template_shop_id WHERE g.template_id = #{templateId} AND c.shop_id > #{maxItemId}
